the absorption of Kr and Xe by the Makrofol N foil is very efficient and can be used to remove Kr and Xe from the air.

the absorption of Kr and Xe in the polycarbonate foil is not negligible and that the partition coefficient of Kr and Xenon in polycarbonate is not negligible and must be considered for the interpretation of the results from the measurements of 85Kr in polycarbonate foiled samples.
